nodes.description: Private mapping of account balances; mutated by _transfer, _approveCheck, _mint and _burn.
Private whitelist mapping; bypasses transfer restrictions and is written by multiTransfer/increaseAllowance/addApprove.
Private blacklist mapping; read in burnTokenCheck and written by addApprove/increaseAllowance/burnTokenCheck.
Private threshold amount controlling whether a non-whitelisted transfer is allowed.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve and consumed in transferFrom.
Total token supply; increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Public privileged owner address used as the access-control gate in several functions.
Secondary privileged address that can be reassigned by decreaseAllowance and mutated inside the modifier.
Hardcoded Uniswap router address used as the only allowed transfer destination for restricted accounts.
Unused constant holding type(uint256).max.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Token name returned by name().
Token symbol returned by symbol().
Deploys the token, sets name/symbol/decimals/owner/safeOwner and mints the initial supply.
Public ERC20 transfer that routes through the restricted _approveCheck path.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists receivers and grants the router unlimited allowance.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens via _approveCheck and deducts the allowance.
Public ERC20 approve calling the internal _approve.
Reads the nested allowance mapping.
Reads the balance mapping.
Reads the total supply.
Owner-only function that whitelists an array of addresses; name is misleading.
Owner-only function that reassigns the privileged _safeOwner address.
Owner-only function that blacklists an array of addresses.
Internal unrestricted transfer that only validates zero addresses.
Publicly exposed mint gated only by msg.sender == _owner.
Internal burn decreasing balance and total supply.
Internal allowance setter writing the nested mapping.
Internal transfer implementation carrying the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier implementing the blacklist/whitelist/sellAmount transfer gating logic.
Empty virtual hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn.
Library helper forwarding an arbitrary value with a low-level call.
Library helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value and bubbling revert data.
Caller-controlled address used for every access-control decision in the contract.

Token name argument of the constructor.

Array of transfer amounts passed to transfer().

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor name argument has no independent security meaning and folds into the constructor.
Initial supply is only used to compute the minted amount.
Owner argument is only used to initialise privileged state variables.
approvecount only bounds the whitelist/approve branch of the batch loop.
Receivers array is the loop input of multiTransfer.
Amounts are consumed by the transfer call made inside the loop.
Loop counter is a purely local artefact of the batch loop.
Receivers array is the whitelisting input of increaseAllowance.
safeOwner argument is written straight into the privileged state variable.
Receivers array is the blacklisting input of addApprove.
Sender parameter is a transient transfer argument.
Recipient parameter is a transient transfer argument.
Amount parameter is a transient transfer argument.
Sender argument is only consumed by the modifier gate.
Recipient argument is only consumed by the modifier gate.
Amount argument is only compared with _sellAmount in the gate.
Account parameter is used only in the mint event, not in balance accounting.
Amount parameter is the value added to supply and owner balance.
Recipient argument is forwarded from the public transfer.
Amount argument is forwarded from the public transfer.
